title: Cap cargo build jobs and test threads by default in the Windows test runner so a FULL cannot exhaust Central's commit memory
outcome: Cap cargo build jobs and test threads by default in the Windows test runner so a FULL cannot exhaust Central's commit memory
acceptance: scripts/test-rust.ps1 (and the launcher path that invokes it) bound cargo parallelism by default: build jobs and test threads have a conservative default cap on Windows unless the caller passes an explicit value (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS/ENGRAM_TEST_THREADS or a flag), and the effective values are printed in the run log.
A Windows FULL with defaults completes on Central without commit exhaustion; the run log records the effective job and thread counts and peak commit.
Linux and macOS behaviour is unchanged unless explicitly opted in.
